name: Cave Zen - Just one way out!

ios.desc:
Cave Zen is an action adventure game that uses all your skills and senses. Move Cave Zen through levels and find the exit! You'll learn the super simple controls at lightning speed and control Cave Zen in a hurry through the tricky worlds. Only you can help me! 
 
◉ Avoid traps, open doors & swing bombs!
◉ You control me super easy. Simply draw the path!
◉ Tricky? The endless levels are really cool.
◉ Explore complex levels ...
◉ ... and compare your success with other players!

User review:
◉ Fun game to play. Very addictive.
◉ Cool graphics and gameplay.
◉ Very impressive, offers a unique gaming experience that has an addictive edge.

Features:
◉ Easy, normal and hard levels
◉ Random generated stack caves
◉ Various obstacles
◉ Gravity effects
◉ Fresh and easy to learn control
◉ 40 unique levels
◉ Funny characters
◉ GameCenter support
◉ HelpDesk support
◉ Supports iPhone and iPad
